decisions.reason: Requesting a complete on-page SEO report does not change the underlying image ALT optimization behavior or its observed failure.
The report request may describe completed on-page work but does not change the webpage content revision requirement.
The on-page SEO completion report is distinct from the existing Friday weekly work summary, and the source does not replace or modify that reporting schedule.
Backlink creation is off-page SEO work and remains unchanged by the request for an on-page SEO report.
The on-page SEO report request does not alter the separate off-page backlink indexing requirement.
Requesting an on-page SEO report does not change the selected campaign keywords, keyword count, or mapped page.
The report request does not modify the number, publication conditions, or delivery of the SEO blogs.
